segments.an7.29:1.3: Bhikkhudassanaṃ hāpeti, saddhammassavanaṃ pamajjati, adhisīle na sikkhati, appasādabahulo hoti, bhikkhūsu theresu ceva navesu ca majjhimesu ca upārambhacitto dhammaṃ suṇāti randhagavesī, ito bahiddhā dakkhiṇeyyaṃ gavesati, tattha ca pubbakāraṃ karoti.
segments.an7.29:1.10: Ime kho, bhikkhave, satta dhammā upāsakassa parihānāya saṃvattanti.
segments.an7.29:2.3: Bhikkhudassanaṃ na hāpeti, saddhammassavanaṃ nappamajjati, adhisīle sikkhati, pasādabahulo hoti, bhikkhūsu theresu ceva navesu ca majjhimesu ca anupārambhacitto dhammaṃ suṇāti na randhagavesī, na ito bahiddhā dakkhiṇeyyaṃ gavesati, idha ca pubbakāraṃ karoti.
segments.an7.29:2.10: Ime kho, bhikkhave, satta dhammā upāsakassa aparihānāya saṃvattantī”ti.
segments.an7.29:2.12: Idaṃ vatvāna sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā –
segments.an7.29:5.3: Tattheva ca pubbakāraṃ, yo karoti upāsako.
segments.an7.29:9.3: Idheva ca pubbakāraṃ, yo karoti upāsako.

lines: Navame bhikkhudassanaṃ hāpetīti bhikkhusaṅghassa dassanatthāya gamanaṃ hāpeti.
Tattha ca pubbakāraṃ karotīti tesaṃ bāhirānaṃ titthiyānaṃ datvā pacchā bhikkhūnaṃ deti.
